source: Original — generic running distances for building interval sessions. Not transcribed from a specific published programme.

exercises.name: 60m
exercises.cue: Full effort, drive out low, get up to top speed and hold it.

exercises.name: 100m
exercises.cue: Strong drive phase, then relax into your top speed.

exercises.name: 150m
exercises.cue: Fast but controlled — hold your form as the fatigue kicks in.

exercises.name: 200m
exercises.cue: Strong and even pace, don't go off too fast.

exercises.name: 300m
exercises.cue: Controlled speed, focus on relaxed arms and a tall posture.

exercises.name: 400m
exercises.cue: Even effort all the way round, save something for the last 100m.

exercises.name: 600m
exercises.cue: Settle into a strong, sustainable rhythm early.

exercises.name: 800m
exercises.cue: Even pacing across both laps, resist the urge to start too fast.

exercises.name: 1000m
exercises.cue: Settle into a rhythm you can hold, breathe controlled.

exercises.name: 1200m
exercises.cue: Steady, controlled effort — find a pace you can repeat.

exercises.name: 1600m (Mile)
exercises.cue: Patient start, even splits, save your kick for the final lap.
